title: Your Lead Response and WhatsApp Follow-Up System

sections.label: 1 - A LEAD WRITES IN
sections.note: Web form, Instagram DM or Facebook DM all land on one webhook, get cleaned into the same shape, and are saved in Supabase before anything else runs.

sections.label: 2 - INSTANT ALERT AND FIRST REPLY
sections.note: The team hears about the lead in Slack, and the lead gets a WhatsApp reply with a booking link, both within seconds of writing in.

sections.label: 3 - FOLLOW UP UNTIL BOOKED
sections.note: One day later it checks Supabase. Booked or replied means confirm and put it on the calendar. Silence means a gentle nudge, wait two days, check again.

sections.label: 4 - WHEN THEY REPLY ON WHATSAPP
sections.note: Twilio posts the inbound message back in. The model reads it and routes it: book the time, hand a real question to a human, or stop messaging them for good.

sections.label: 5 - NOTHING FAILS QUIETLY
sections.note: If any step in the flow errors, Slack gets the lead, the step and a link to the failed run, so a silent break never costs a booking.

2 - Normalize the Lead

nodes.notes: Then back to the same check. Capped, so nobody gets chased forever.
